headline: 8 die in a day as dengue toll hits 433 this year
summary: Nearly 2,000 patients were hospitalised in 24 hours, with over 6,000 currently in inpatient care across Bangladesh.
details: Bangladesh has recorded eight more dengue deaths in a single day, bringing the total death toll for the year to 433.

headline: Schoolboy injured by brickbat amid Ashulia garment worker protests
summary: A 10-year-old student was hit on the head during demonstrations for a higher minimum wage. Protests also saw a covered van torched and clashes with police.
details: A 10-year-old schoolboy, Nuruzzaman Sami, was injured when he was struck by a flying brickbat during garment worker protests in Ashulia on Monday. He was treated at Nasir Uddin Memorial Hospital for a head injury and bleeding.
Photos of the bloodied child have circulated online, with some falsely claiming police were responsible. However, local police stations reported no information about the incident.
The protests were part of a nationwide call by garment workers for a minimum monthly wage of Tk 30,000. Demonstrations escalated into clashes with law enforcement.

During the unrest, protesters torched a covered van and engaged in confrontations with police. Several factories in the Narsinghpur, Nishchintapur, and Kathgora areas declared holidays due to the ongoing disturbances.
caption:
A 10-year-old schoolboy was injured by a brickbat during garment worker protests in Ashulia.

Demonstrations demanding a higher minimum wage also saw a covered van torched and clashes with police.

A 10-year-old schoolboy, Nuruzzaman Sami, was injured when he was struck by a flying brickbat during garment worker protests in Ashulia on Monday. He was treated at Nasir Uddin Memorial Hospital for a head injury and bleeding.

Photos of the bloodied child have circulated online, with some falsely claiming police were responsible. However, local police stations reported no information about the incident.

The protests were part of a nationwide call by garment workers for a minimum monthly wage of Tk 30,000. Demonstrations escalated into clashes with law enforcement.

During the unrest, protesters torched a covered van and engaged in confrontations with police. Several factories in the Narsinghpur, Nishchintapur, and Kathgora areas declared holidays due to the ongoing disturbances.
